# AXA Industries

> AXA Industries presents institutional hygiene and waste-management equipment, including sanitary napkin vending machines, sanitary napkin disposal equipment, washroom feedback systems, and solid-waste incinerators. Contact AXA Industries for current specifications, availability, and quotations.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://axaindustries.com/): Overview of AXA Industries products and institutional solutions.
- [Products](https://axaindustries.com/products): Product catalogue.
- [Sanitary napkin vending machines](https://axaindustries.com/sanitary-napkin-vending-machine): Institutional vending options, model-selection guidance, applications, and enquiry form.
- [Sanitary napkin vending machine price](https://axaindustries.com/sanitary-napkin-vending-machine-price): Current listed price guidance and quote factors.
- [Sanitary napkin incinerators](https://axaindustries.com/sanitary-napkin-incinerator): Disposal equipment information.
- [Sanitary waste disposal machine](https://axaindustries.com/sanitary-waste-disposal-machine): Sanitary waste disposal options.
- [Menstrual waste management](https://axaindustries.com/menstrual-waste-management): Planning information for institutions.
- [Delhi NCR enquiries](https://axaindustries.com/sanitary-napkin-vending-machine-delhi-ncr): Regional enquiry information.
- [About AXA Industries](https://axaindustries.com/about): Company information.
- [Contact](https://axaindustries.com/contact): Contact and enquiry options.

## Information notes

- Confirm product specifications, prices, taxes, delivery, installation, and warranty directly with AXA Industries before procurement.
- Product availability and quoted terms may change; use the current product pages and a written quotation.
- The XML sitemap is available at https://axaindustries.com/sitemap.xml.
